from pathlib import Path
import sys
d=Path(sys.argv[1])
p=Path('README.md').read_text().splitlines()
(d/'requirements-prose.md').write_text('\n'.join(p[:10])+'\n')
groups={'lru.go':[(17,17),(26,26),(31,32),(58,58),(77,77),(94,94),(102,103),(111,112),(120,122),(143,145),(167,167),(184,184),(203,203),(220,220),(228,228),(236,236),(244,244),(252,252)],'doc.go':[(22,23)],'simplelru/lru.go':[(12,12),(23,23)],'simplelru/lru_interface.go':[(9,10),(13,14),(17,17),(20,20),(23,23),(26,26),(29,29),(32,32),(35,35),(38,38),(41,41),(44,44),(47,47)]}
parts=[]
for f,rs in groups.items():
 lines=Path(f).read_text().splitlines()
 for a,b in rs:
  partes=[x.lstrip() for x in lines[a-1:b]]; assert all(x.startswith('// ') for x in partes)
  parts.append(f'{f}:{a}\n'+'\n'.join(x[3:] for x in partes))
(d/'contracts.txt').write_text('\n\n'.join(parts)+'\n')
